newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico records $264 mln trade surplus for August.
newsitem.headline: Mexico records $264 mln trade surplus for August.

text.p: Mexico's trade surplus for August was $264 million, the Finance Ministry said Saturday.
Exports in August were $7.813 billion, while imports were $7.549 billion, it said.

Petroleum exports represented 12.0 percent of the total exports. Of the non-petroleum exports, manufacturing made up 84.3 percent of that total, up 9.2 percent compared with the same month a year earlier.
The ministry said the accumulated trade surplus for the first eight months totaled $4.830 billion.
In the first eight months, exports totaled $61.335 billion, it said.

Manufacturing exports in August totaled $6.626 billion, up 9.2 percent over August 1995, farming exports in the month totaled $208 million, up 4.3 percent from the same month a year earlier, the ministry said.
Imports in August were up 17.8 percent over the same month in 1995, it said, and totaled $56.505 billion in the first eight months of the year, up 20.2 percent over the same period a year earlier.
